claims.head: The Golden Knights’ defense joins the attack, the Kings’ stays home
claims.body: The Golden Knights’ defensemen shoot a lot, and the Kings’ not so much. Vegas is near the top of the league for shots from defensemen, and Los Angeles is the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Watch the Golden Knights’ defensemen jump into the play.

VGK.head: This one sets up well for the Golden Knights
VGK.body: Vegas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Kings’ best way in is keeping dangerous shots away.

LAK.head: The Kings are up against it
LAK.body: Vegas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Kings can still win it if they keep dangerous shots away, but a lot has to go their way.

story.head: Stone’s favorite opponent
paras: The Golden Knights have won three straight. The Kings are still looking for their first win of the season, 0-2-1 through three games.
